observations: Visible title, author, DOI and attribution-license statement agree with the source inventory; the license version remains unspecified.
Six material cards are visible above the safety warning; the source contract does not enumerate the cards.

The warning says to read appropriate SDS before work. A visible Sort By Relevance/Name/Formula Weight string occurs inside the warning box and is also present in extracted text; classify it as possible export UI residue, not a safety instruction, pending source-owner review.
Six numbered steps and the 1x/10x, pH, optional DEPC, acid and autoclave branches are visible.

Rendered chemical notation uses subscripts; pypdf inserts a private-use glyph after phosphate notation and Poppler loses at least one separator in the 10x line. Neither extraction is approved as a machine-readable formulation.
